// DRAWS VANILLA'S COPY OF THIS MESH (2026-10-02), because BD_RPG now inherits WM_RPG
// and its card names Vanilla's surfaces -- drum, rocket1..rocket7. The two rpg_wm.md3
// files are the same asset (8482 verts, 7550 tris, same bbox) exported twice: Vanilla
// into 10 named surfaces, BD22 into 13 with the rockets as fixed2..fixed10. A card
// naming one mesh while its prop draws the other is silent -- it validates, it draws,
// and the rig then moves surfaces by names the drawn mesh has never heard of.
//
// THE OFFSET CHANGED WITH THE PATH. Identical geometry does NOT mean identical origin:
// the two were re-origined by different pipelines. Scale is shared (the 0.34 unit
// convention); the offset is WM_PropRocketLauncher's, the MAIN-hand prop for this mesh,
// because BD_RPG is hand = main while WM_RPG itself is the off-hand card. Keeping the
// old offset would have drawn the gun 3.2 units out in y and 2.8 in z.
Model BD_PropRPG
{
	Path "models/vanilla/launchers/RPG"
	Model 0 "rpg_wm.md3"
	Skin 0 "rpg.png"
	Scale -0.3400 0.3400 0.3400
	Offset 1.1050 -4.8185 3.0015
	PlacementCVars bd_rpg
	NOAUTOREVERSE
	NoInterpolation
	FollowMainHand
	FrameIndex WMPR A 0 0
}
